name: Zlokljuchenie Diany
source:
Diana is a young woman who lost her beloved husband — a man she truly idolized — in a tragic car accident. Five years have passed, and Diana has struggled to heal this profound emotional wound. But now, a series of events is about to tear that old scar wide open once again.

[From [url=https://manager-xgame.itch.io/diana]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
戴安娜是一位年轻女子，在一场悲惨的车祸中失去了她深爱的丈夫——她真正崇拜的男人。五年过去了，戴安娜一直在努力治愈这种深刻的情感创伤。但现在，一系列的事件即将再次撕开那道旧伤疤。

[来自[url=https://manager-xgame.itch.io/diana]itch.io[/url]]
